name: @nikon-camera-bridge/desktop
description: Electron desktop shell for Webcam Bridge for Nikon

scripts.build:win: electron-vite build && electron-builder --win msi --x64 --publish never --config.directories.output=release/win-x64-msi && electron-builder --win msi --arm64 --publish never --config.directories.output=release/win-arm64-msi && electron-builder --win zip --x64 --publish never --config.directories.output=release/win-x64-zip && electron-builder --win zip --arm64 --publish never --config.directories.output=release/win-arm64-zip && electron-builder --win msix --x64 --publish never --config.directories.output=release/win-x64-msix && electron-builder --win msix --arm64 --publish never --config.directories.output=release/win-arm64-msix
scripts.build:linux: electron-vite build && electron-builder --linux deb --x64 --publish never --config.directories.output=release/linux-x64-deb && electron-builder --linux deb --arm64 --publish never --config.directories.output=release/linux-arm64-deb && electron-builder --linux AppImage --x64 --publish never --config.directories.output=release/linux-x64-appimage && electron-builder --linux AppImage --arm64 --publish never --config.directories.output=release/linux-arm64-appimage && electron-builder --linux flatpak --x64 --publish never --config.directories.output=release/linux-x64-flatpak && electron-builder --linux flatpak --arm64 --publish never --config.directories.output=release/linux-arm64-flatpak
scripts.build:mac: electron-vite build && electron-builder --mac dmg --x64 --publish never --config.directories.output=release/mac-x64-dmg && electron-builder --mac dmg --arm64 --publish never --config.directories.output=release/mac-arm64-dmg

author: AMDphreak

linux.synopsis: Webcam bridge and control shell for Nikon USB cameras
